description: This file defines the schema and backend operations for managing cluster membership data in etcd, including saving, deleting, and reading member info, cluster version, and downgrade info.

classes.name: membershipBackend
classes.description: Struct managing backend storage operations for cluster membership, including saving, deleting, and reading members, versions, and downgrade info.

methods.name: NewMembershipBackend
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new membershipBackend instance with provided logger and backend.

methods.name: MustSaveMemberToBackend
methods.description: Saves a membership.Member to the backend, marshaling it to JSON.

methods.name: MustHackySaveMemberToBackend
methods.description: Updates a member in a less strict way, used for fixing issues.

methods.name: TrimClusterFromBackend
methods.description: Removes all cluster version info from backend.

methods.name: MustDeleteMemberFromBackend
methods.description: Deletes a member by ID from backend and marks it as removed.

methods.name: MustReadMembersFromBackend
methods.description: Reads all members and removed members from backend.

methods.name: readMembersFromBackend
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve members and removed members from backend storage.

methods.name: TrimMembershipFromBackend
methods.description: Removes all member and removed member info from backend.

methods.name: MustSaveClusterVersionToBackend
methods.description: Saves cluster version info to backend.

methods.name: MustCreateBackendBuckets
methods.description: Creates necessary buckets for members, removed members, and cluster info.
